description: Build a Transfer Player (201) event command for insertion via insert_event_commands — move the party to (x, y) on a map. With designation "variable", mapId/x/y are variable ids resolved at runtime. Read-only: returns { command }.

designation.description: direct: mapId/x/y are literal; variable: they are variable ids (default direct)

mapId.description: Destination map id (or a variable id if designation=variable)

x.description: Destination tile x (or a variable id)

y.description: Destination tile y (or a variable id)

name: build_transfer_player
